label: Vehicle
definition: A conveyance asset whose maintenance status is tracked by the fleet organization.

label: Scheduled Service
definition: A planned maintenance activity assigned to a vehicle for a specified service date or planning window.

label: Required Part
definition: A part specified as necessary for completing a scheduled service type.

label: Assigned Depot
definition: A depot designated as responsible for servicing a vehicle.

label: Depot Inventory
definition: A dataset or information content entity describing part quantities available at a depot.

label: Service Risk Assessment
definition: An assessment that identifies vehicles at risk of missing scheduled service because supporting conditions are not satisfied.
